sourceTitle: Supplement to the catalogue of seals and whales in the British Museum
description: "Supplement to the Catalogue of Seals and Whales in the British Museum" by John Edward Gray is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. The work serves as an extensive supplement to the existing catalogue of seals and whales held by the British Museum, detailing various species, their classifications, and anatomical characteristics.
